name: zclass_camera_render_frustum_grid_tiles
description: zClass_Camera::RenderFrustumGridTiles renders frustum grid world-area children with per-tile clip masks, light-mode reset, fog restoration, and final ring index state.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because frustum tile rings, world-area cells, light data, and camera/fog state still render with HLIL artifacts around ring pointer arithmetic and x87 distance comparisons.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera render helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44ce70 validates helper selection by world virtual-area/clamp flag, early return on grid-build failure, fog-state capture and restoration, ring/tile traversal through all 50 frustum grid rings, optional camera offset update, HSE projected-sphere skip, per-tile lightSubMode updates and final reset, fog toggling by tile distance, clip-mask stack write, in-bounds child dispatch, VAP_statics filtering for offset tiles, final camera update, and final g_zClass_RenderFrustumGridTileIndex value 50.

The native render-frustum-grid smoke verifies a controlled two-by-two in-world footprint dispatches children in diamond-ring order with clip mask 0x3f, restores fog enabled state, resets lightSubMode to enabled, and leaves g_zClass_RenderFrustumGridTileIndex at 50.
